scores.rationale: The plan is a component catalogue with no phases or build order, so nothing shows substrate-first sequencing.
No Phase 0 or thin end-to-end production slice is defined; all components are specified at once.
Irreversible choices (Kafka, isolation model, providers, DB) are made silently with no defaults or flip conditions.
There are no phases, so no ordering of wide-impact work before leaf work; reporting and tenancy sit in arbitrary order.

scores.evidence: Row-Level Security: Use database policies for multi-tenancy
scores.rationale: A security section lists sensible controls, but it is a standalone list not tied to phases.
A monitoring section exists, but it is standalone and not present from a first phase.
Nothing on reproducible builds, environments, IaC, or migrations.
Idempotency key column and webhook logs exist, but the code uses a random UUID per call and the failure handling is not phased.
The plan never addresses whether an AI layer applies, so it does not declare N/A.
No deferred work or pull-forward conditions; it ends by offering to go deeper.

note: This is a component and schema catalogue, not a phased build plan. It has some security and monitoring content but no sequencing, decision gates, or deferrals.
